note: Every launch that exists on 0G mainnet, and what each one is. Read from the two factories rather than remembered. allProjects is append-only with no delete, so this list can only grow -- which is exactly why it is written down once here instead of being re-explained every time totalProjectsCount() is read. audit_consistency.mjs checks this file against the chain and fails only when an on-chain launch is NOT accounted for here.
